1. This is a petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C., 1973 seeking quashing of FIR No. 862/2021 dated 19.12.2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, 1860 registered at PS : Nangloi, Delhi and consequent proceeding emanating therefrom on the grounds of settlement having been arrived at between the parties.

2. Learned counsel appearing for the parties submit that under the aegis of the Delhi Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, parties have been able to resolve their disputes and reduced the same into writing vide the Report dated 10.01.2023.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/09/2023 at 21:22:26 3.

According to the terms of the settlement, the petitioners are to pay to respondent No.2 a sum of Rs. 5 lakhs towards full and final settlement qua all the claims regarding permanent alimony, dowry,
stridhan and maintenance for past, present and future.

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that sum of Rs. 4 lakhs has already been remitted to the respondent No.2 in the interregnum.
5. Respondent No.2 is present in person and affirms the fact that a sum of Rs. 4 lakhs has already been remitted to her account.

6. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the balance amount in the sum of Rs. 1 lakh is being paid to the respondent No. 2 in Court today by way of a Demand Draft No. 264741 dated 04.09.2023 drawn on Kotak Mahindra Bank, Noida Sector-16.
The same has been handed over to respondent No.2, who affirms the receipt of the same.
7. The I.O. is present in person and identifies the parties appearing before this Court today.

8. This Court has interacted with respondent No.2, who submits that she is well aware of the terms of settlement and affirms the receipt of the full and final settlement amount and she has no objection in case the present FIR is quashed.
9. The parties have also been able to dissolve their marriage by way of a decree of divorce under the provisions of Section 13B of the HMA, 1955.
The copy of the decree dated 05.04.2023 is placed on record at page No. 48 of the present petition.
10. This Court has perused the terms of settlement agreement and This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/09/2023 at 21:22:26 they appear to be lawful.
The parties are bound by the terms of the settlement.

11. After observing that the disputes are arising from matrimonial ties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no purpose would be served in continuing with the FIR in question and the further criminal proceedings and it would be in the interest of justice as also of the parties and the society that quietus is put to such disputes.
12. Accordingly, FIR No. 862/2021 dated 19.12.2021 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC, 1860 registered at PS : Nangloi, Delhi and the proceedings emanating therefrom are hereby quashed.
13. The petition is disposed of accordingly.
TUSHAR RAO GEDELA, J SEPTEMBER 18, 2023/nd
